result.note: Brief item on India's battery-cell incentive programme. Tested its claims, installed capacity against target, and the contrasting auto scheme figures in one statements question.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India's battery-cell incentive programme, as reported in July 2026:
items: The programme had drawn no incentive claims.
Installed capacity stood at 1 GWh against a target of 50 GWh.
The parallel incentive scheme for the auto sector drew USD 4.6 billion in investment.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three statements are correct. The battery-cell programme had no incentive claims and only 1 GWh installed against a 50 GWh target. By contrast, the parallel auto scheme drew USD 4.6 billion in investment and 67,820 jobs.
questions.source: India's battery-cell programme has drawn no incentive claims at all, with just 1 GWh installed against a 50 GWh target, even as the parallel auto scheme drew USD 4.6 billion in investment and 67,820 jobs.
